card.title: PlayStation 4 Mainboard Married Components Guide and Diagnostic Info

claims.statement: The components permanently married to the PlayStation 4 mainboard include the 2x DDR memory, Blu-ray controller (Mediatek or Renesas), APU, NOR IC Flash memory, and SYSCON IC.
claims.evidence: Mainboard architecture maps identifying married components.
claims.quote: Which components are married to the mainboard 13 56 16 1 2x DDR memory Blu-ray controller (Mediatek or Renesas) 36 47 APU NOR IC Flash memory SYSCON IC

claims.statement: If the console stays at 99mA current draw with no boot during standby sequence, it could mean that the southbridge is bad or the 32Khz crystal is not oscillating.
claims.evidence: Standby boot sequence current monitoring and crystal oscillation check.
claims.quote: If it stays at 99mA with no boot it could mean that the southbridge is bad. Check the 32Khz crystal if it oscillates. If the 32Khz signal is missing, then replace the southbridge clean flux of the board.

claims.statement: Error CE-35888-2 typically indicates a Renesas IC problem in the Blu-ray drive which is not repairable.
claims.evidence: Error code definition from diagnostic documentation.
claims.quote: While the disc drive itself may be functioning, encountering this error typically indicates a Renesas IC problem, which is not repairable.

procedure: Connect PIN 1 (+5VSB) and PIN 4 (+5VSB enable) of the +5Vstby connector to the positive terminal of a power supply set to +5V to monitor current draw during the boot sequence.
Verify the normal standby boot sequence current draw stages: first stage 23mA, second stage 125mA, working state 30mA.
Test the power supply by connecting the small white connector (+5 Vstby) and pressing power to check if +12 Von is generated.
Measure capacitor impedance on the APU and RAM to check their health.

measurements.context: Checking for shorts on standby power rails (+1,8V, +3,3V, +1,1V)

cautions: SOURCE RISK: Removing shield with hot air can cause solder bridging near HDMI filters or components.
card.caveats: Married components like the SYSCON, APU, and NOR flash cannot be easily swapped individually without transferring or reprogramming matching sets.
